exact: positive regulation of blood/brain barrier permeability
narrow: activation of maintenance of permeability of BBB
activation of maintenance of permeability of blood-brain barrier

definition: Any process that increases blood-brain barrier permeability, the quality of the blood-brain barrier that allows for a controlled passage of substances (e.g. macromolecules, small molecules, ions) into and out of the brain.
label: positive regulation of blood-brain barrier permeability
